evidence.excerpt: This work simplifies selection by framing it as a constrained local search problem and presents local demonstration editing (LDE).

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: At test time, Jev-LDE executes a single edit of the retrieved demonstration set, followed by one inference from the target LLM, avoiding the need for iterative context scoring or subset searches.
